bibman_core_library_notes: v9: an access code (Script Property BIBMAN_ACCESS_CODE) and ADMIN_EMAILS replace the access sheet. Install it with Frontend Code.gs 12. In each web app: Libraries → BibManCore → select version 9, then Deploy → Manage deployments → Edit → New version
bibman_frontend_thinclient_webapp_notes: v12: new Code.gs (access code instead of the access sheet); set the Script Properties BIBMAN_ACCESS_CODE and ADMIN_EMAILS first, select Core 9, redeploy
bibman_bookmarklet_capture_webapp_notes: v8: select Core 9 and redeploy (Code.gs unchanged)
